title: Determining limiting distance
jurisdiction: British Columbia (specific local authority not named in published decision)

facts.text: A proposed combustible mixed-use Part 3 building lies beside a four-storey combustible mixed-use building with unprotected openings at the property line. A restrictive covenant sets a 1,525 mm (5 ft) setback from the property line over its length.

The local authority treated the covenant line as the limiting-distance datum for both properties; the appellant argued the property line controlled and the existing adjacent building was non-conforming.
The decision quotes the definition of limiting distance and Appendix note A-3.2.3. about legal agreements establishing a different datum.
